cands.name: Samuel Vilchez Santiago
cands.bio: Orange County Democratic Party chair, age 29, and senior manager for nonprofits at ActBlue. Venezuelan political refugee who grew up in East Orlando; Colonial High valedictorian with degrees from Princeton and Oxford (campaign site).
cands.local_ties: Grew up in East Orlando; attended Colonial High and Roberto Clemente Middle (campaign site, Florida Politics).

record.text: Won the August 2026 Democratic primary with 66% over former Rep. Daisy Morales; chairs the Orange County Democratic Party.

controversies.text: Former Rep. Daisy Morales sued him and the Florida House Democratic Campaign Committee in Orange Circuit Court for libel over primary mailers that depicted her as backing Republicans; the suit was still pending as of Oct. 29, 2026.

endorsements.text: U.S. Rep. Maxwell Frost, Sen. Carlos Guillermo Smith, Rep. Anna Eskamani, Orange County Mayor Jerry Demings, Orlando Mayor Buddy Dyer, outgoing Rep. Johanna Lopez; Orlando Sentinel editorial board.

cands.gaps: No photo found. Fundraising totals not retrieved. His employer, ActBlue, is a Democratic fundraising platform (his own guide answer). cands.name: Jorge Malavet
cands.bio: Retired U.S. Navy Supply Corps officer (20 years), 56; former U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services Southeast region manager and chief of staff. Holds a J.D. and a master of public administration (campaign site). Described as a Trump supporter.

record.text: Career includes Navy department head aboard a ballistic-missile submarine, USDA APHIS administrative officer, and USCIS regional budget chief and chief of staff (campaign site). Age and occupation also in the News Collaborative guide.
